steps.name: ipython

program_text='''def transform(grid):
    # Find a uniform row or column that separates equal-size panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and r == h - r - 1 and r > 0:
            candidates.append(("row", r))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c == w - c - 1 and c > 0:
            candidates.append(("col", c))
    if not candidates:
        raise ValueError("no uniform separator between equal panels")
    axis, pos = candidates[0]
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:pos], grid[pos + 1:]
    else:
        a = [row[:pos] for row in grid]
        b = [row[pos + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"expected one shared panel color, got {shared}")
    base = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if x == base and y == base else base for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
'''
